title: Statistical estimates
description: Every estimate the site can render: point, clustered CI, paired test, BH-adjusted q, power, pass^k. Pre-registered and exploratory estimates are distinguished so the UI can visually demote the latter. Objects are closed so a typo becomes a schema failure rather than a field the site silently ignores.

hypothesis_id.description: The PREREGISTRATION.yaml hypothesis this row was scored against. Null means the check was not declared and the row is exploratory.

denominator_label.description: What n counts, in words. Rendered next to the sample size so a rate is never shown without its denominator's meaning.

exploratory.description: Rendered with a dashed rail and an explicit chip, grouped below the pre-registered estimates. Non-negotiable.

cluster.description: The resampling unit. Must be cluster_id (the originating source applicant), not a response or pair_id; sibling profiles and contrasts are dependent.

fallback_used.description: true when BCa failed and percentile bootstrap was used instead. Propagates to the UI automatically, so the site can never claim BCa when percentile ran.

degenerate.description: true when every bootstrap replicate equalled the observed statistic, which is the normal state for a deterministic scripted control. A zero-width interval is then a property of the known-answer design, not a precision claim.

n_inapplicable.description: Results excluded because the comparison could not be constructed. Disclosed, never folded into the denominator as a pass.

n_error.description: Results excluded because a leg was unilaterally incomplete. A one-sided incompletion cannot support a paired claim in either direction.

b.description: Discordant pairs where the base arm approved and the counterfactual arm did not.

c.description: Discordant pairs where the base arm was adverse and the counterfactual arm approved.

p.description: Two-sided exact p-value. Valid but conservative on a discrete statistic; this is the value multiplicity control consumes.

p_mid.description: Mid-p variant. Approximately uniform under the null and reported for calibration diagnostics only; deliberately not the value BH consumes.

stratum.description: Which sample pass^k was computed on. Required so the caption can never be omitted.

n_excluded.description: Units dropped for running fewer than k trials. pass_1 and pass_k are computed on the same surviving units so the two are directly comparable.
